verdict.rationale: Bruno's own docs say it keeps credentials out of version control through secret variables and vaults. It also documents external secret-manager integrations: Azure Key Vault with CLI authentication, and GCP Secret Manager support added in a release. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how secret variables are masked and kept out of the plain-text collection files, a broader list of supported vault providers with setup depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can keep credentials out of shared files with masked secrets or an external vault integration

citations.quote: Keep credentials out of version control with secret variables and vaults.

Azure CLI authentication feature allows you to authenticate with Azure Key Vault using your existing Azure CLI session, without requiring manual entry of Tenant ID, Client ID, or Client Secret in Bruno.
feat(secrets): add GCP Secret Manager support
